captures.description: THE SERVICE, SIGNED OUT, 2026-11-01: 'You can check if your visual artwork or photos were included in popular AI image-generation datasets by visiting Have I Been Trained?.' What the tool does (the dataset searched, 'LAION-5B dataset, a massive collection of roughly 5.8 billion image-text pairs'; how to check, by name, keywords or an uploaded image; limitations, 'It does not search text-based training data used by large language models'); how to opt out (Spawning AI's Do Not Train Registry; robots.txt for text); a follow-up offer. Four cards: Mentionable AI, Facebook, a YouTube clip (AI Samson), www.toolcenter.ai.
